Evidence: Advani stated he never intended to not contest from Gandhinagar, despite earlier expressing a desire to shift to Bhopal due to reported differences with Narendra Modi. He later decided to contest from Gandhinagar following intervention from the RSS and party leadership, who believed not contesting from Gujarat would send the wrong signals. Advani confirmed he was happy to be contesting from Gandhinagar, emphasizing his long-standing ties to the area (Sources 1, 2, 3).
Justification: The retrieved evidence indicates that Advani did not refuse to contest from Gandhinagar; rather, he changed his mind after pressure from the RSS and party leadership. He explicitly stated he never intended to not contest from there, contradicting the claim that he refused despite pressure. Thus, the evidence refutes the claim.
